annotation.authors_or_issuer: 運輸省 (Ministry of Transport; now MLIT, Japan)
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines specified maintenance (特定整備) to include electronic control device maintenance covering driving-assist sensors and automated driving systems (自動運行装置) (Art. 3).
Art. 31-2-2 sets conditions for automated driving device use, requiring conformity with Article 48 of the Road Vehicle Safety Standards.
Specified maintenance businesses need qualified mechanics, equipment, and technical information for ADAS calibration (aiming) (Arts. 57, 62-2-2).
Prescribes vehicle inspection, registration, type approval, and certification procedures and registered testing bodies.
Establishes registered information processing/provision bodies with security requirements.
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Ordinance for Enforcement of the Road Vehicles Act (Ministry of Transport Ordinance No. 74 of 1951, current revision effective 20 Oct 2026). It sets procedures for vehicle registration, inspection, type approval, maintenance businesses and information bodies, with provisions on driving-assist sensors and automated driving devices in specified maintenance and conditions.
